subject.title: feat(workboard): clarify proof provenance and diagnostics

question: Should `independently_verified` remain a required shared Workboard proof value when Workboard only records the caller's declaration and does not itself verify the evidence?
rationale: The code can safely persist and display the field, but its durable public meaning determines whether downstream automation and operators may treat it as an authority signal.

options.title: Endorse caller-declared provenance
options.body: Merge with the documented contract that `independently_verified` is metadata supplied by the caller and never an attestation by Workboard.

options.title: Use a less authoritative contract
options.body: Rename or narrow the value before merge so consumers cannot reasonably mistake it for independent verification.

recommendation.title: Endorse caller-declared provenance
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented contract that `independently_verified` is metadata supplied by the caller and never an attestation by Workboard.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history identifies this contributor as the only concrete current Workboard contact, though long-term ownership is not established by the available evidence.
